gaps: Pay plan (grade and step tables with minimum/maximum for every classification) is not posted. Job postings mention a 'Step Plan' and Ordinance 3246 mentions 'Paygrade classification of 23 or higher', but the schedule itself was not found. Request the current General Employee pay plan and step tables from Human Resources (Ch. 119).

Police and fire step or rank pay tables and any collective bargaining agreements (police, fire, general employees) were not found online. Request any current CBAs, or confirm that none exist, plus the sworn step plans.

Department head, police chief and fire chief salaries are not published. Request current annual salaries for the City Manager (with COLAs since 2024), Assistant City Managers, City Clerk-Treasurer, Police Chief, Deputy Chief, Fire Chief, Assistant Fire Chief and Directors.
Per-member pay for the Mayor and Commissioners is not itemized. Request the ordinance or resolution setting commission salaries, or the payroll register amounts.
Whether the City Clerk-Treasurer contract with Leslie Glaze was approved as proposed ($145,000) could not be confirmed. Request the Sept 8, 2026 minutes and the executed contract.
FY2027 position counts by title were not in the 9/17/2026 budget report. The adopted FY2027 budget book with personnel schedules was not yet posted as of 2026-10-21.

The GovernmentJobs class-specification listing (294 classes) shows one rate per class, from mixed and undated revisions; for example, Police Officer II shows $42,328 while the current Police Officer I posting starts at $51,958.40. Those figures were left out as unreliable.
Payroll register with actual pay by position (unnamed) is not online. Request a calendar-2025 or FY2026 payroll extract by title and department.
notes: FY2026 funded positions total 645 (General Fund 448.71; CRA 2.5; Housing funds 8; Utilities 109.98; Environmental Services 53.81; Marinas 7; Equipment Maintenance 15). The book lists 752 authorized.

FY2027 budget: the COLA was removed. Step increases were kept for eligible employees, and employees in Grade 24 and below (excluding Directors and above) get a one-time net payment of $1,000 full-time / $500 part-time. Ten more vacant General Fund positions were unfunded (Sept 17, 2026 memo).
